title: 从Agent故障路径到量化残余风险：韧性Agentic AI的组合框架
summary: 提出CPSAINT七层完整性分解与FRIESA-K残余风险函数，将故障路径映射为量化风险实例，通过受控吸收马尔可夫模型推导控制有效性，支持跨域推理与可组合信任。
summary_en: Proposes CPSAINT seven-layer integrity decomposition and FRIESA-K residual-risk functional, mapping failure paths to quantified risk instances via controlled absorbing Markov models for cross-domain reasoning and composable trust.
